The '''''Storm Carrier''''' was a [[Hover barge/Legends|hoverbarge]] converted into a warship by the mercenary force, [[InterStellar Regulators]]. Hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during their occupation of [[Makeb]], the Regulators' [[vice-commandant]] used the warship as his main base of operations. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike force took the carrier down due to the mercenaries' actions in the occupation hindering the Republic rescue effort.
